sentences.en: By and by, the bitter north wind began to blow.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，刺骨的北风开始吹起。

sentences.en: The town is located in the extreme north of Japan.
sentences.zh: 这座城市位于日本最北部。

sentences.en: Americans are all heading north to the land of opportunity.
sentences.zh: 美国人正纷纷向充满机会的土地——北方进发。

senses.zh: 在北方，向北方North诺斯(姓氏)
